summary: Deviating, principally because required-check workflow identity is discarded. All 176 focused GitHub tests and three CLI scenarios passed. cargo test --workspace failed at the batch_pull_request schema/golden expectation; a supplementary retry was stopped during the long forge fault sweep. Every named MQ ID has test/scenario coverage, but MQ-18 real workflow triggering remains unverified. No copied Mergify prose or code detected; repository files were unchanged.
